title: 第21章 你身上的煞气怎么消失了第22章 声如玉磬
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 暮色四合，天边的晚霞如打翻的胭脂盒，晕染出绚丽的橙红与紫绯。
书阁小院浸在这片暖光中，白日余温未散，投下长长的影子。
莲公主随手将李叶青放在院子中央的青石板上，自己轻巧地退开几步，活动着手腕脚踝，脸上漾着一种混合了狡黠与兴奋的笑容，全无平日皇室贵女的端庄持重，倒像个即将恶作剧得逞的顽童。
“公……公主殿下，小人修为低微，实在不堪您一击啊！”
李叶青看着莲公主那跃跃欲试的模样，头皮一阵发麻，试图做最后的挣扎。
元丹境对开窍境，这哪里是喂招，分明就是碾压。
再加上公主的表情。
“少废话！”
莲公主眼睛一瞪，非但不怒，兴致反而更高。
“本公主屈尊给你当陪练，是多少人求都求不来的福分！”
“不敢。”
李叶青心中哀叹，但见莲公主那不容置疑的神情，知道这顿“切磋”是躲不掉了。
他只得硬着头皮，暗暗运转《混元功》，气血奔流，全身戒备地盯着前方。
“准备好咯？我来啦！”
莲公主轻笑一声，身形一动，并未施展什么玄妙身法，只是速度极快，宛如黄昏归巢的燕子，直扑而来，一掌轻飘飘地拍向李叶青的胸口。
李叶青瞳孔一缩，下意识施展出《混元功》的配套步法，侧身滑步，险险避开。
掌风擦着他的衣角掠过，带起的劲气刮得他皮肤隐隐生疼。
“咦？反应不慢嘛！”
莲公主略显惊讶，攻势却毫不停滞，化掌为指，指尖萦绕着淡淡金芒，疾点李叶青肩井穴。
李叶青全力催动内息，将身法施展到极致，在方寸之地腾挪闪避，身形狼狈。
他根本不敢硬接，只能凭借初步蜕变的神识带来的敏锐感知，预判莲公主的攻击轨迹，勉力周旋。
院子里，但见莲公主身影飘忽，攻势如潮，李叶青则像夕照下波涛中的一叶扁舟，颠簸起伏，随时可能倾覆。
“只会躲吗？拿出点真本事来！”
莲公主似乎觉得不过瘾，攻势骤然加紧，拳、掌、指、腿连绵不绝，如疾风骤雨。
虽压制了修为，但招式精妙，力量控制得恰到好处，既让李叶青感到泰山压顶般的压力，又不至于真的将他重创。
李叶青叫苦不迭，他哪有什么攻击性的“真本事”？
《混元功》长于养气固本，配套的招式也以防御、卸力为主，攻伐手段匮乏。在莲公主这轮猛攻下，他很快左支右绌。
一声闷响，李叶青终究未能完全避开，肩头被莲公主的掌缘扫中。
一股不算霸道却异常精纯凝练的力量透体而入，震得他气血翻涌，踉跄着倒退数步才勉强站稳，喉头一甜，险些喷出血来。
“太慢了！力量也散！”
莲公主收势而立，微微蹙眉点评，夕阳在她身后勾勒出一圈光晕，“你的内息还算浑厚，但运用起来呆板生硬，犹如守着一座宝山却不知如何利用！
临敌之际，岂能如此拘泥成法？意随心动，气随意走，懂不懂？”
李叶青喘着粗气，肩头火辣辣地疼，虽然这丫头是存心戏耍他，不过说的倒是不错。
他以往修炼，多是按部就班冲关练气，与人实战的经验几乎空白，更别提与莲公主这等高手“切磋”。
此刻在这巨大的压力下，他对内息运转、招式应变的体会，变得无比直观而深刻，尽管这体会伴随着痛楚。
“再来！”莲公主不容他喘息，再次攻上。
content_en:
The twilight is all around, and the sunset glow on the horizon is like an overturned rouge box, smearing with brilliant orange-red and purple.
The small courtyard of the bookstore is immersed in this warm light. The remaining warmth of the day has not dissipated, casting long shadows.
Princess Lian casually placed Li Yeqing on the bluestone in the center of the courtyard. She took a few steps back lightly, flexing her wrists and ankles, with a smile that was a mixture of cunning and excitement on her face. She was not at all dignified and steady as a royal lady, but more like a naughty boy who was about to pull off a prank.
"My lord...your highness, the villain is of low cultivation and cannot bear your blow!"
Li Yeqing's scalp felt numb as he looked at Princess Lian's eagerness to make a final struggle.
In the Yuandan realm versus the Kaiqiao realm, this is not a feeding move, it is clearly a crushing move.
Plus the princess’s expression.
"Cut the nonsense!"
Princess Lian's eyes widened. Instead of being angry, she was even more interested.
"This princess condescends to be your sparring partner. This is a blessing that no one can ask for!"
"Don't dare."
Li Yeqing lamented in his heart, but seeing Princess Lian's unquestionable expression, he knew that this "discussion" could not be avoided.
He had no choice but to bite the bullet and secretly run the "Hunyuan Gong", with blood flowing and his whole body staring ahead with vigilance.
"Ready? I'm coming!"
Princess Lian chuckled lightly and moved. She did not use any mysterious skills, but she was very fast. Like a swallow returning to its nest at dusk, she rushed straight towards Li Yeqing and slapped Li Yeqing's chest with a light palm.
Li Yeqing's pupils shrank, and he subconsciously used the matching footwork of "Hunyuan Gong", sliding sideways and narrowly avoiding it.
The wind from his palm brushed against the corner of his clothes, and the force caused by the blow made his skin feel faintly painful.
"Huh? You're not slow to respond!"
Princess Lian was slightly surprised, but her offensive did not stop. She turned her palms into fingers, with a faint golden glow lingering on her fingertips, and quickly tapped Li Yeqing's Jianjing acupoint.
Li Yeqing mobilized his inner energy with all his strength, exerted his body skills to the extreme, and evaded in a small area, his body was in a mess.
He didn't dare to attack directly. He could only rely on the keen perception brought by his initial transformation of spiritual consciousness to predict the trajectory of Princess Lian's attack and try his best to deal with it.
In the courtyard, Princess Lian's figure was seen erratic, attacking like a tide, while Li Yeqing was like a small boat in the waves under the sunset, bumping and undulating, and might capsize at any time.
"Can you only hide? Show some real skills!"
Princess Lian seemed to feel that it was not enough, and her offensive suddenly intensified, with fists, palms, fingers, and legs flowing in an endless stream, like a gust of wind and rain.
Although his cultivation was suppressed, his moves were exquisite and his power was controlled just right, which not only made Li Yeqing feel the pressure of Mount Tai, but also prevented him from being seriously injured.
Li Yeqing complained endlessly, how could he have any "real ability" to be aggressive?
"Hunyuan Gong" is good at nourishing Qi and consolidating the foundation. The supporting moves are mainly defensive and unloading, and there is a lack of offensive means. Under Princess Lian's fierce attack, he was quickly overwhelmed.
"Bang!"
There was a muffled sound, but Li Yeqing was unable to completely avoid it, and his shoulder was struck by the edge of Princess Lian's palm.
A force that was not overbearing but was extremely pure and concise penetrated into his body, causing his blood to surge. He staggered back a few steps before he could barely stand still. His throat felt so sweet that he almost spurted blood.
"Too slow! The power is gone!"
Princess Lian stood up and commented with a slight frown, the setting sun outlined a circle of light behind her, "Your inner breath is quite strong, but the use of it is stiff and stiff, like guarding a treasure mountain but not knowing how to use it!
How can you be so rigid when facing an enemy? The mind moves as the heart moves, the energy moves as the heart desires, do you understand? "
Li Yeqing was breathing heavily, and his shoulders were burning. Although this girl was deliberately teasing him, what she said was good.
In his past training, he mostly practiced qi in a step-by-step manner, and had almost no experience in actual combat with others, let alone "sparring" with masters like Princess Lian.
At this moment, under this huge pressure, his understanding of the inner flow of energy and the adaptability of moves became extremely intuitive and profound, even though this experience was accompanied by pain.
"Come again!" Princess Lian didn't allow him to breathe and attacked again.
